name: NextPlus Banner
author: shariaone39

sections.description:
“I keep writing posts, but traffic never grows” — this plugin is a no-ad-budget way for WordPress sites to gain visitors.

NEXT+ is a mutual referral platform where websites, apps, and local shops introduce customers to each other. It is operated by us, the authors of this plugin. When you place the banner with this plugin:

  • Your readers see nearby deals from other participating sites and shops
  • Every time the banner is tapped, your site earns referral points
  • Your points determine how often your own site is recommended on other participating sites, bringing you new visitors

Unlike SEO or social media, there are no rankings or followers to grow first. Your site becomes part of the referral network the day you install the banner.

Note: the NEXT+ network currently serves Japanese websites, so the plugin’s user interface is provided in Japanese.

Features

  • Just place it: choose from the [nextplus_banner] shortcode, a block, or automatic insertion after each post
  • No performance impact: the banner is lazy-loaded with a fixed height, so it causes no layout shift (CLS)
  • SEO-safe: the banner is delivered inside an iframe, so search engines do not treat it as link exchange
  • Always up to date: banner design improvements are delivered server-side, with no plugin update needed
  • Measurable: see impressions, clicks, and referrals in the NEXT+ analytics dashboard

How to start

  1. Sign up for NEXT+ (free) and enter your site’s information
  2. Copy the link URL shown in the NEXT+ banner management screen
  3. Paste it in this plugin’s settings page (Settings > NEXT+バナー) and save

Registration and usage are free.

日本語での説明

「記事は書いているのに、アクセスが増えない」——そんなWordPressサイト・ブログのための、広告費のかからない集客・アクセスアップのプラグインです。バナーを1つ貼るだけで、参加サイト同士がユーザー(読者)を紹介し合う相互送客ネットワーク「NEXT+(ネクプラ)」に参加できます。バナーがタップされるたびに送客ポイントが貯まり、その分だけあなたのサイトが他の参加サイトのバナーやAIの気持ち検索で紹介され、新しい読者の流入が生まれます。

相互リンクのようにSEOペナルティの心配はなく(バナーはiframe配信のため被リンクになりません)、SEOやSNS運用のように育てる時間も不要です。ブログの集客、ホームページのアクセスアップ、Webサービス・アプリの宣伝に。登録・利用は無料です。

  • 使い方: ショートコード [nextplus_banner]、ブロック、記事末尾への自動挿入
  • 費用: 無料(登録・月額とも)
  • 対象: ブログ、ホームページ、Webサービス、アプリ、実店舗サイト

External Services

This plugin connects to the external service “NEXT+” (https://www.nextplus.link), which is operated by the plugin authors, to display the banner.

  • What is loaded: the banner (an iframe) corresponding to the installation token you save in the settings page is loaded from nextplus.link
  • What is sent: when the banner is displayed or clicked, the visitor’s browser sends the same information as any normal web request (IP address, User-Agent, etc.) to the NEXT+ server. The plugin itself does not send any personal data stored in your WordPress site
  • Terms of service: https://www.nextplus.link/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://www.nextplus.link/privacy

A free NEXT+ account is required to display the banner.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for NEXT+ (free) and enter your site’s information
  3. Copy the link URL shown in the NEXT+ banner management screen
  4. Paste it in Settings > NEXT+バナー and save
  5. Turn on automatic insertion after posts, or place the [nextplus_banner] shortcode or the “NEXT+ バナー” block where you want the banner to appear
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

No. Registration and monthly usage are both free.

How does my traffic grow?

Every time your banner is tapped (= you send a reader to another site), your site earns referral points. Your points determine how often your own site is recommended in other participating sites’ banner slots and in the NEXT+ AI-powered search. The more you send, the more you are recommended.

Can any site join?

Any publicly available site can join, regardless of genre. All participating sites are reviewed by the NEXT+ team.

Is this the same as reciprocal linking?

No. Reciprocal links are an SEO technique of exchanging links for search-engine ranking, which risks penalties when overdone. The NEXT+ banner is delivered inside an iframe, so it is not counted as a backlink by search engines. Instead, it introduces real human readers between sites.

Does the banner slow down my site?

No. It is lazy-loaded, so it does not delay your page’s initial render, and its height is fixed so it causes no layout shift (CLS).
